description: Read the newest orders for this site's shop, optionally filtered by payment status. Returns order summaries, buyer names and emails, totals and fulfillment status. Use get_shop to inspect shop settings.

limit.description: Number of recent orders to return, 1 to 50. Defaults to 25.

siteName.description: Site name as returned by list_sites.

status.description: Only return orders with this payment status.

name: list_shop_orders
title: List recent shop orders
